An earlier death or retirement is not assumed and would not, without an applicable legal basis, establish earlier termination of the fixed permission itself. The name search found no later held match; other selected searches found no numbered hits. Their limitations remain explicit: name/OCR matching cannot authenticate identity or exclude every variant, 85 orders lack held text, the OFR catalog begins in 1937, and USC coverage stops October 9, 2026. They are bounded counterevidence checks, not silence used as an ending. No unresolved positive continuation lead remains. There is no separate office, general rule or continuing duty to inventory after the personal term, and accrued rights do not prolong it. Same-family AI production; human certification is false and independent whole-case review remains required.
